title: Enable amount formatting with currency symbols
summary: Amount formatting now supports displaying currency symbols or ISO codes before or after values using AL format-string tokens, with a new Default position option that defers to General Ledger Setup settings.
key_points: Currency Symbol Position enum gains a Default value and its existing values are re-IDed
Amount formatting emits currency text through AL <S,...> format tokens instead of plain text
Foreign currencies set to Default use the General Ledger Setup position
Upgrade code keeps stored General Ledger Setup and Currency values meaningful in W1 and affected country layers
Amount format tests split into session-isolated codeunits covering symbols, codes, positions and never-show
quote: enables amount and unit-amount controls to display configured currency symbols or ISO currency codes before or after the formatted value
